name: Arimura Noa
source:
"Please don't mind me, I'm not interested."
"Huh? What is that~ how troublesome! Don't involve me!"

A girl with an interest in science, whose father is a genius robot engineer.
She's rational, private, and a realist which combines into a rather dry personality.
At school she's a taciturn honor student, but when school is over she turns into a gal who goes out to clubs to pick up boys.
